title: UI pass visible everywhere and project-neutral: lineup and rounds in run, waves, runtree; ui.md names the project's design doc

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S117 later notes (2026-10-26): the ui lineup row and UI pass rounds do not show in ork run's plan (internal/cli/run.go:154), Waves (internal/tui/waves.go:464), the launch view, the run tree and activity views. internal/roles/prompts/ui.md hardcodes ork paths (docs/dashboard.md, golden views), but the engine runs other projects too; the brief should name the project's design doc instead.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner to pick at preflight where the project's design doc path comes from (registry field or a fixed fallback). UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/cli ./internal/tui ./internal/roles ./internal/engine; goldens; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
